controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties.
controls.justification: Fundamental governance requirement establishing executive management direction and institutional backing for ISMS.
controls.treatment_strategy: Approved executive security policies maintained in version-controlled repository.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.
controls.justification: Defines operational hierarchy, assigning CSCO, CISO, and engineering leads formal accountability.
controls.treatment_strategy: DevSuperSuite CSCO and engineering roles codified in corporate governance charter.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.
controls.justification: Prevents unauthorized modifications and single points of collusion across deployment gates.
controls.treatment_strategy: Multi-party branch protection and required peer reviews enforced via GitOps pipeline.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy and topic-specific policies of the organization.
controls.justification: Ensures proactive leadership enforcement and compliance adherence across all operational units.
controls.treatment_strategy: Mandatory managerial sign-offs and quarterly compliance review gates.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.
controls.justification: Essential for regulatory incident notifications (e.g., GDPR 72h breach notification, SEC disclosures).
controls.treatment_strategy: Designated emergency contacts with CISA, CERT, and data protection commissioners.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.
controls.justification: Maintains up-to-date threat intelligence and cryptographic migration recommendations.
controls.treatment_strategy: Active membership in OWASP, FIRST, Linux Foundation, and NIST PQC workshops.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.
controls.justification: Drives dynamic STRIDE attack modeling, IOC detection, and defensive postures.
controls.treatment_strategy: Continuous STRIDE attack graph simulation and automated CVE threat feeds.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management.
controls.justification: Embeds DevSecOps security gating and threat modeling into sprint lifecycles.
controls.treatment_strategy: Mandatory security acceptance criteria and automated SAST pull request gates.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.
controls.justification: Ensures complete asset visibility and software bill of materials (SBOM) tracking.
controls.treatment_strategy: SPDX v2.3 and CycloneDX v1.5 automated SBOM generation with cryptographic digests.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.
controls.justification: Establishes operational boundaries preventing data exfiltration and misuse.
controls.treatment_strategy: Acceptable Use Policy signed by all engineers and reinforced by technical DLP checks.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate shall return all the organization assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.
controls.justification: Prevents unauthorized retention of hardware tokens, workstations, or credentials.
controls.treatment_strategy: Offboarding runbook revoking hardware PKCS#11 keys and cryptographic certificates.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified in accordance with the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.
controls.justification: Defines handling regimes for Restricted, Confidential, Internal, and Public assets.
controls.treatment_strategy: 4-tier data classification matrix applied to all repository assets and databases.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.
controls.justification: Provides automated metadata tagging for DLP and egress filtering.
controls.treatment_strategy: Standardized classification headers attached to all compliance reports and API payloads.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.
controls.justification: Governs secure transport across air-gapped SCIF boundaries and external channels.
controls.treatment_strategy: Hardware unidirectional optical data diode and ML-KEM hybrid TLS 1.3 transfers.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.
controls.justification: Enforces principle of least privilege (PoLP) and Zero-Trust access.
controls.treatment_strategy: Zero-Trust SSH/mTLS bastion with cryptographic session recording and MFA tokens.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.
controls.justification: Ensures unique cryptographic identity lifecycle for workloads, services, and operators.
controls.treatment_strategy: SPIFFE/SPIRE X.509 SVID automated identity provisioning and ephemeral rotation.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.
controls.justification: Guarantees cryptographic protection of passwords, seeds, and API keys.
controls.treatment_strategy: FIPS 140-3 hardware PIN-protected token keys with hardware retry rate limiting.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.
controls.justification: Prevents privilege creep through periodic automated access recertification.
controls.treatment_strategy: Quarterly RBAC entitlement reviews and automatic token revocation upon lease expiration.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier products or services.
controls.justification: Mitigates third-party software and cloud dependency vulnerabilities.
controls.treatment_strategy: Mandatory vendor SOC 2 Type II attestation verification and ISO 27001 screening.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.
controls.justification: Binds suppliers to breach notification timelines and security SLAs.
controls.treatment_strategy: Standard DevSuperSuite Master Services Agreement (MSA) with strict DPA clauses.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.
controls.justification: Guarantees SLSA Level 3 build integrity and prevents dependency tampering.
controls.treatment_strategy: Hermetic builds, pinned container digests, and SLSA Level 3 cryptographic provenance.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.
controls.justification: Ensures supplier compliance posture is continuously re-assessed against evolving standards.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated dependency lockfile drift detection and vendor risk audits.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization information security requirements.
controls.justification: Governs multi-cloud container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code hardening.
controls.treatment_strategy: Immutable container baselines, read-only root filesystems, and strict resource quotas.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.
controls.justification: Establishes runbooks for rapid incident containment, investigation, and reporting.
controls.treatment_strategy: Incident Response Plan (IRP) with automated alerting and failover orchestration.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.
controls.justification: Provides systematic event triage, reducing alert fatigue and false negatives.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated SIEM rule correlation assigning severity scores (P1-P4) in real time.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.
controls.justification: Executes immediate containment actions (e.g. host isolation, token invalidation).
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated eBPF socket severance isolating compromised pods within microseconds.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.
controls.justification: Continuous feedback loop driving regression tests and defensive invariant updates.
controls.treatment_strategy: Blameless post-mortem process with mandatory automated test cases for every incident.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: The organization shall define and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.
controls.justification: Ensures forensic admissibility and tamper-proof audit trails for legal proceedings.
controls.treatment_strategy: RFC 6962 binary Merkle tree hash chaining and Ed25519 cryptographic sealing.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
controls.justification: Guarantees security controls remain fail-closed and unbypassed during disaster events.
controls.treatment_strategy: Fail-closed network partitions and split-brain Raft consensus protection.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.
controls.justification: Verifies sub-second failover, zero data loss (RPO = 0), and rapid MTTR (< 3.2s).
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated DR failover gate and multi-region chaos engineering resilience testing.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.
controls.justification: Maintains adherence to GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, and export control regulations.
controls.treatment_strategy: Regulatory mapping engine tracking compliance obligations across all enterprise jurisdictions.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.
controls.justification: Protects proprietary algorithms, trade secrets, and enforces third-party OSS license compliance.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated SPDX software bill of materials license scanning denying copyleft contamination.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release in accordance with legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.
controls.justification: Ensures immutable WORM storage of corporate financial, security, and audit ledgers.
controls.treatment_strategy: Cryptographically hashed append-only JSON ledgers and tamper-evident signatures.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.description: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations and contractual requirements.
controls.justification: Enforces GDPR Art. 25/32 privacy-by-design and HIPAA encryption mandates.
controls.treatment_strategy: Quantum-resistant field-level AES-256-GCM encryption and pseudonymous tokenization.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: The organization approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.
controls.justification: Mandates third-party Big-4 SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 accredited audit assessments.
controls.treatment_strategy: Annual Big-4 independent surveillance audits and automated continuous evidence vault.

controls.title: Compliance with policies and standards for information security
controls.description: Managers shall regularly review the compliance of information processing and procedures within their area of responsibility with the appropriate security policies, topic-specific policies and standards.
controls.justification: Guarantees continuous compliance verification across all operational engineering teams.
controls.treatment_strategy: Continuous automated SAST/DAST regression scanning on every pull request.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to all personnel who need them.
controls.justification: Standard operating procedures (SOPs) eliminate operational variance and human error.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated runbooks and comprehensive air-gap installation guides.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.
controls.justification: Ensures trustworthy personnel are vetted prior to receiving access to production systems.
controls.treatment_strategy: Mandatory background screening, criminal checks, and identity verification before onboarding.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel and the organization responsibilities for information security.
controls.justification: Binds all employees legally to security standards and confidentiality obligations.
controls.treatment_strategy: Employment contracts include strict IP assignment and confidentiality agreements.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization information security policy.
controls.justification: Prepares staff against phishing, social engineering, and secure coding lapses.
controls.treatment_strategy: Mandatory quarterly security training and periodic simulated phishing campaigns.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.description: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.
controls.justification: Establishes clear operational repercussions for intentional policy breaches or reckless disregard.
controls.treatment_strategy: Formal progressive disciplinary policy codified in Employee Handbook.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated to the relevant personnel and other interested parties.
controls.justification: Maintains non-disclosure and confidentiality obligations after departure.
controls.treatment_strategy: Exit interview checklist reinforcing perpetual NDA and trade secret protection.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization needs for protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties.
controls.justification: Provides legal recourse for unauthorized disclosure of trade secrets or client data.
controls.treatment_strategy: Universal bilateral NDA execution prior to sharing proprietary architectural blueprints.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization premises.
controls.justification: Secures off-premise engineering environments against interception and device theft.
controls.treatment_strategy: Encrypted full-disk BitLocker/FileVault, mandatory WireGuard VPN, and Zero-Trust bastion.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.description: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.
controls.justification: Empowers prompt escalation of security anomalies by all organizational members.
controls.treatment_strategy: Dedicated security hotline (`security@devsupersuite.com`) and anonymous reporting portal.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
controls.justification: Protects air-gapped SCIF facilities and cryptographic hardware appliances from physical intrusion.
controls.treatment_strategy: Classified SCIF physical boundary specifications with multi-tier access control.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.
controls.justification: Prevents unauthorized entry into server rooms and hardware vault enclaves.
controls.treatment_strategy: Biometric badge readers, anti-passback turnstiles, and audited visitor escorts.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and implemented.
controls.justification: Isolates operational engineering enclaves from public access areas.
controls.treatment_strategy: Interlocking doors and physical compartmentalization of development and hosting zones.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
controls.justification: Provides real-time deterrence and forensic investigation of perimeter breaches.
controls.treatment_strategy: 24/7 CCTV surveillance with 90-day retention and AI-driven intrusion detection alarms.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure shall be designed and implemented.
controls.justification: Prevents catastrophic hardware failure from fire, flood, or thermal extremes.
controls.treatment_strategy: Gaseous fire suppression, redundant HVAC chillers, and water detection sensors.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.
controls.justification: Strict controls for sensitive cryptographic key ceremonies and air-gapped staging.
controls.treatment_strategy: Two-person rule (2PR) enforced for hardware HSM token initialization and key ceremonies.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.
controls.justification: Eliminates opportunistic visual eavesdropping and unattended active terminal sessions.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated 5-minute screen lock policy and clean desk policy enforced by security patrols.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected.
controls.justification: Prevents unauthorized viewing of monitors and secures server racks from physical damage.
controls.treatment_strategy: Locked server cabinets with privacy filters on workstations in open areas.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Off-site assets shall be protected.
controls.justification: Secures corporate laptops and hardware tokens outside controlled physical premises.
controls.treatment_strategy: Centralized MDM device tracking, remote wipe capability, and hardware disk encryption.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organization classification scheme and handling requirements.
controls.justification: Prevents data leakage through decommissioned NVMe/SSD drives or backup tapes.
controls.treatment_strategy: NIST SP 800-88 Rev 1 cryptographic erase and physical degaussing/shredding procedures.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.
controls.justification: Maintains continuous processing power for mission-critical microservices.
controls.treatment_strategy: N+1 redundant UPS battery banks and automatic on-site diesel generator failover.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.description: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.
controls.justification: Prevents wiretapping and electromagnetic eavesdropping on fiber links.
controls.treatment_strategy: Armored conduit routing, fiber optic tamper seals, and MACsec Layer 2 encryption.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.
controls.justification: Ensures hardware reliability while preventing unauthorized access during servicing.
controls.treatment_strategy: Scheduled preventive hardware maintenance performed exclusively under escort.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.
controls.justification: Guarantees zero-residual client data leakage when hardware components retire.
controls.treatment_strategy: DoD 5220.22-M 4-pass zeroization and certificate of destruction for all decommissioned media.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.
controls.justification: Prevents malware infiltration, token theft, and unauthorized exfiltration from developer machines.
controls.treatment_strategy: Hardware PKCS#11 FIPS 140-3 token requirement, disk encryption, and EDR agent telemetry.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
controls.justification: Restricts root/administrator capabilities and eliminates standing administrative privileges.
controls.treatment_strategy: Just-In-Time (JIT) ephemeral credential elevation with quorum approval and session capture.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.
controls.justification: Enforces fine-grained role-based (RBAC) and attribute-based (ABAC) data filtering.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated ABAC policy engine enforcing tenant data isolation across API endpoints.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.
controls.justification: Prevents unauthorized code tampering, backdoor injection, and intellectual property theft.
controls.treatment_strategy: Signed Git commits with PKCS#11 hardware tokens, strict branch protection, and CI gating.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
controls.justification: Enforces phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication (FIDO2/WebAuthn/mTLS).
controls.treatment_strategy: Cryptographic hardware token authentication and SPIFFE mutual TLS certificates.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.
controls.justification: Prevents denial-of-service through resource starvation and runaway workloads.
controls.treatment_strategy: Kernel cgroups v2 memory/CPU limits and dynamic autoscaling thresholds.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
controls.justification: Prevents execution of malicious payloads, ransomware, and unauthorized binaries.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated AST dependency scanning, Shannon entropy checks, and binary hash matching.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained, the organization exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.
controls.justification: Continuous SAST/DAST/SCA vulnerability management guaranteeing 0 critical and 0 high CVEs.
controls.treatment_strategy: Real-time regex, entropy, and AST security scanner coupled with STRIDE attack graph simulation.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.
controls.justification: Eliminates configuration drift and enforces hardened container baselines.
controls.treatment_strategy: GitOps declarative infrastructure as code with automated drift detection and remediation.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Data stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.
controls.justification: Guarantees complete cryptographic zeroization of ephemeral secrets and client PII.
controls.treatment_strategy: FIPS 140-3 4-pass zeroization (DoD 5220.22-M) ensuring 0.0000 entropy and zero RAM leakage.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.
controls.justification: Prevents exposure of sensitive PAN/PII data in logs, non-production environments, and APIs.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated token redaction regexes masking credit card numbers, JWTs, and API credentials in telemetry.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.
controls.justification: Mechanically blocks unauthorized exfiltration of corporate intellectual property.
controls.treatment_strategy: Fail-closed eBPF socket interlock dropping non-whitelisted outbound network connections.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and system images shall be taken and tested regularly in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.
controls.justification: Guarantees survivability and immediate restoral of operational data stores.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated snapshot replication with immutable object locking and daily restoral dry runs.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.
controls.justification: Eliminates single points of failure across infrastructure clusters.
controls.treatment_strategy: Multi-region active-active container clustering with automated load balancing.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
controls.justification: Maintains indisputable audit trails for security investigations and forensic reconstruction.
controls.treatment_strategy: Centralized SIEM stream with SHA-256 Merkle log auditing and immutable WORM retention.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
controls.justification: Enables proactive detection of compromise, DDoS attacks, and unauthorized probing.
controls.treatment_strategy: eBPF kernel probe telemetry tracking every network connection and process invocation.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems shall be synchronized to approved time sources.
controls.justification: Ensures accurate forensic timeline reconstruction and replay attack defense.
controls.treatment_strategy: Network Time Protocol (NTP) synchronization against authenticated Stratum-1 time servers.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.
controls.justification: Prevents administrative backdoors or security tool circumvention.
controls.treatment_strategy: Zero-Trust bastion command interceptor strictly blocking raw gdb, strace, and hex editors.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage the installation of software on operational systems.
controls.justification: Prevents unauthorized binary installations on production hosts.
controls.treatment_strategy: Read-only container root filesystems (`read_only: true`) and distroless base images.

controls.title: Network security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
controls.justification: Enforces fail-closed socket drops, air-gapped subnet boundaries, and denies public IP egress.
controls.treatment_strategy: Linux eBPF LSM and sock_ops kernel probe program dropping all unauthorized CIDR egress.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.
controls.justification: Guarantees confidentiality and availability across internal RPC and service mesh interfaces.
controls.treatment_strategy: Mutual TLS (mTLS) with SPIFFE identity verification across all microservice mesh calls.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated on networks.
controls.justification: Prevents lateral movement between tenant workloads, management planes, and storage enclaves.
controls.treatment_strategy: Isolated internal Docker networks (`internal: true`) and Kubernetes default-deny NetworkPolicies.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.
controls.justification: Blocks outbound C2 callback infrastructure, phishing domains, and untrusted registries.
controls.treatment_strategy: Zero-trust DNS proxy and eBPF socket interlock mechanically denying external web egress.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
controls.justification: Implements NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM-768/1024), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA), and FIPS 140-3 hardware PKCS#11 HSM vaulting.
controls.treatment_strategy: Hybrid post-quantum key exchange (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) and hardware-rooted FIPS 140-3 HSM.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.
controls.justification: Ensures security is designed and tested into every development phase from ideation to release.
controls.treatment_strategy: Mandatory automated SAST, DAST, SBOM generation, and pre-commit security hooks.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
controls.justification: Codifies formal application threat models and authentication specifications before coding.
controls.treatment_strategy: STRIDE threat modeling and formal security architecture review checklists.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.
controls.justification: Enforces defense-in-depth, fail-safe defaults, and least privilege in software architecture.
controls.treatment_strategy: Zero-trust microsegmentation, ephemeral credentials, and air-gapped SCIF topologies.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
controls.justification: Eliminates OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities (SQLi, command injection, SSRF, memory leaks).
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated AST invariant security gates enforcing parametrized queries and memory safety.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.
controls.justification: Validates resilience through automated penetration testing and fuzzing harnesses.
controls.treatment_strategy: Automated pytest compliance harness executing 1,200+ security regression tests in CI.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.
controls.justification: Ensures external software components comply with enterprise coding and security standards.
controls.treatment_strategy: Mandatory cryptographic SLSA provenance verification and vendor SAST gating.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.
controls.justification: Prevents unauthorized production modifications and inadvertent data pollution.
controls.treatment_strategy: Isolated network bridges and cryptographically partitioned container namespaces.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.
controls.justification: Enforces auditable change authorization, automated canary rollouts, and rollback readiness.
controls.treatment_strategy: GitOps automated release controller with automated canary rollback capabilities.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, secured and managed.
controls.justification: Prevents real production customer PII from leaking into development or test suites.
controls.treatment_strategy: Synthetic dummy fixtures and Shannon entropy checks ensuring zero real tokens in test code.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving the assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
controls.justification: Prevents penetration testing or audit scans from causing production system outages.
controls.treatment_strategy: Read-only auditor credentials, staged testing windows, and rate-limited scanner policies.
